title: Indian Contract Act, 1872 — Section 204 (Revocation where authority has been partly exercised)

content.overview: The principal cannot revoke the authority given to his agent after the authority has been partly exercised, so far as regards such acts and obligations as arise from acts already done in the agency.
content.glance: After partial exercise, principal cannot revoke as to acts and obligations arising from acts already done.
content.study: The principal cannot revoke the authority given to his agent after the authority has been partly exercised, so far as regards such acts and obligations as arise from acts already done in the agency. Illustrations distinguish cases where the agent has become personally liable (revocation limited as to payment) from cases where the agent has not (revocation of authority to pay still possible).

sections.heading: No revocation as to completed acts
sections.body: Principal cannot revoke so far as regards acts and obligations arising from acts already done.

provisions.title: Revocation where authority has been partly exercised
